ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first diagnostic assistant optimized for low-bandwidth environments, connecting rural patients to preventive health updates and local clinics via automated IVR and web portals.
ideas.title: GraminHealth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses national building priorities through grassroots healthcare access, matching the proven multilingual community impact style of SAGACITY.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logistics platform matching volunteer drivers and localized transit with isolated rural seniors or community groups requiring transport to agricultural markets or government health camps.
ideas.title: Vanbandhu Connect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages measurable social impact metrics by quantifying community reach and transit efficiency, mirroring the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon grand prize winner.

ideas.pitch: An AI-enhanced infrastructure reporting system that ingests geotagged citizen complaints about local civic issues, automatically categorizes them by severity, and routes them to municipal dashboards.
ideas.title: Samadhan Portal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to nation-building evaluation criteria by providing transparent, real-time civic accountability dashboards for local governance.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first agent running locally or via lightweight web endpoints that intercepts common phone-based financial scams targeting vulnerable populations, translating alerts into regional languages.
ideas.title: Suraksha Voice
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates sophisticated agentic workflows combined with essential societal protection, following the GOSIM Agentic Hackathon winning pattern.

ideas.pitch: A regional agricultural yield and climate risk predictor using statistical regression models to forecast seasonal crop stress and provide early warnings for vulnerable farming communities.
ideas.title: KrishiForecast
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard quantitative data modeling with actionable economic risk mitigation, directly emulating the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner.
